So sustained notes require looping samples; short percussive sounds require short samples (with decay baked in). For a lead with sustain + decay, use a loop of sustain portion... but without envelope, note length = held note; sample loops. Hmm.

Actually, in XM, instruments have volume envelopes in the format. The tool says "Envelopes and note-to-sample mapping are unavailable". So each instrument has one sample presumably, and note on = sample play from 0, loop if flags set, note off = stop (FT2 default has fadeout on note off? - For percussive instruments (drums, bass pluck), use a non-looping sample with decay baked in. If the sample is short, after it ends it goes silent, so the note effectively is one-shot regardless of hold.
- For sustained pads/leads, use a looping sample (loop over the sustain portion) so held notes continue.

reasoning_details.text:
Now let's set a single pattern of 64 rows, put nothing in it, and render to see total duration. Actually rendering with empty pattern: does it render the whole song order? Song length = 1 by default probably. Render and measure WAV duration.

Also test pitch: put a note C-5 in channel 0 with a 440 Hz sine sample recorded at 8363 Hz; measure the frequency in the render.

Let's create sample PCM via python: 1 second of 440 Hz sine at 8363 Hz sample rate → base64 int16.

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace && mkdir -p work submission && cat > work/mk1.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, base64, json
sr=8363
t=np.arange(sr)/sr
sig=0.5*np.sin(2*np.pi*440*t)
pcm=(sig*32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()
b64=base64.b64encode(pcm).decode()
calls=[{"name":"instrument_set","arguments":{"instrument":1,"name":"TESTSINE"}},
       {"name":"sample_create_from_pcm","arguments":{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"pcm":b64,"encoding":"int16","name":"sine440@8363"}},
       {"name":"pattern_set_length","arguments":{"pattern":0,"rows":64}},
       {"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":"C-5","instrument":1}}]
json.dump(calls,open("work/b1.json","w"))

import numpy as np, base64, json
sr=8363.0
N=int(sr*0.3)
t=np.arange(N)/sr
sig=0.4*np.sin(2*np.pi*1000*t)
pcm=(sig*32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()
b64=base64.b64encode(pcm).decode()
notes=["C-3","C-4","C-5","A-4","A-5","-5","D-5","E-5","F-5","G-5","B-4","G#4"]
calls=[]
for i in [0,1]:
    calls.append({"name":"instrument_set","arguments":{"instrument":i+1,"name":"T%d"%i}})
    calls.append({"name":"sample_create_from_pcm","arguments":{"instrument":i+1,"sample":0,"pcm":b64,"encoding":"int16","name":"s1000"}})
calls.append({"name":"pattern_set_length","arguments":{"pattern":0,"rows":64}})
for ch,n in enumerate(notes):
    calls.append({"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":ch,"note":n,"instrument":1}})
# channel 6..9 test instrument2 with same notes
for ch,n in enumerate(notes[:6]):
    calls.append({"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":0,"row":2,"channel":ch+6,"note":n,"instrument":2}})
json.dump(calls,open("work/b2.json","w"))
EOF
python3 work/mk2.py && ft2 batch work/b2.json | tail -c 300"}

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > work/probe2.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, base64, json, subprocess, wave
sr=8363.0
N=int(sr*0.2)
t=np.arange(N)/sr
sig=0.4*np.sin(2*np.pi*1000*t)
b64=base64.b64encode((sig*32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()).decode()
notes=["C-3","C#3","D-3","D#3","E-3","F-3","F#3","G-3","G#3","A-3","A#3","B-3","C-4","C-5","B-4"]
calls=[{"name":"module_new","arguments":{"channels":2,"name":"probe2"}}]
calls.append({"name":"instrument_set","arguments":{"instrument":1,"name":"T"}})
calls.append({"name":"sample_create_from_pcm","arguments":{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"pcm":b64,"encoding":"int16","name":"s"}})
for i,n in enumerate(notes):
    calls.append({"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":0,"row":3*i,"channel":0,"note":n,"instrument":1}})
json.dump(calls,open("work/bp2.json","w"))
r=subprocess.run(["ft2","batch","work/bp2.json"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print("err" in r.stdout.lower(), r.stdout.count("isError\": true"))
subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",'{"path":"work/probe2.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":0}'],capture_output=True)
w=wave.open("work/probe2.wav"); p=w.getparams()
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,p.nchannels).astype(float)[:,0]
row=0.24
for i,n in enumerate(notes):
    s=int((3*i*row+0.02)*44100); seg=d[s:s+int(0.2*44100)]
    if np.max(np.abs(seg))<200: print(n,"SILENT"); continue
    seg=seg*np.hanning(len(seg)); F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg,8192)); f=np.fft.rfftfreq(8192,1/44100.)
    hz=f[np.argmax(F)]
    print(n, round(hz,2), "ratio", round(hz/1000,4), "st from 1000Hz", round(12*np.log2(hz/1000),2))
EOF
python3 work/probe2.py"}

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > work/probe4.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, base64, json, subprocess, wave, sys
def render(path):
    subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",'{"path":"%s","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":0}'%path],capture_output=True)
    w=wave.open(path); p=w.getparams()
    d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,p.nchannels).astype(float)[:,0]
    return len(d)/44100., d
def onset(d):
    nz=np.where(np.abs(d)>500)[0]
    return (nz[0]/44100., nz[-1]/44100.) if len(nz) else (None,None)
sr=8363.
N=int(sr*0.1)
b64=base64.b64encode((0.4*np.sin(2*np.pi*1000*np.arange(N)/sr)*32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()).decode()
calls=[{"name":"module_new","arguments":{"channels":2,"name":"p4"}},
 {"name":"instrument_set","arguments":{"instrument":1,"name":"T"}},
 {"name":"sample_create_from_pcm","arguments":{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"pcm":b64,"encoding":"int16","name":"s"}},
 {"name":"pattern_set_length","arguments":{"pattern":0,"rows":64}},
 {"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":0,"row":40,"channel":0,"note":"F#3","instrument":1}}]
json.dump(calls,open("work/b4.json","w"))
subprocess.run(["ft2","batch","work/b4.json"],capture_output=True,text=True)
t,d=render("work/p4.wav"); print("dur",t,"onset",onset(d))
print(subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_info","{}"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
EOF
python3 work/probe4.py"}

import numpy as np, base64, json, subprocess, wave
sr=8363.
N=int(sr*0.20)
b64=base64.b64encode((0.4*np.sin(2*np.pi*1000*np.arange(N)/sr)*32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()).decode()
vals=list(range(48,68))
calls=[{"name":"module_new","arguments":{"channels":2,"name":"p5"}},
 {"name":"instrument_set","arguments":{"instrument":1,"name":"T"}},
 {"name":"sample_create_from_pcm","arguments":{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"pcm":b64,"encoding":"int16","name":"s"}},
 {"name":"pattern_set_length","arguments":{"pattern":0,"rows":64}},
 {"name":"song_set","arguments":{"bpm":125,"speed":6}}]
for i,v in enumerate(vals):
    calls.append({"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":0,"row":3*i,"channel":0,"note":v,"instrument":1}})
json.dump(calls,open("work/b5.json","w"))
subprocess.run(["ft2","batch","work/b5.json"],capture_output=True,text=True)
subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",'{"path":"work/p5.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":0}'],capture_output=True)
w=wave.open("work/p5.wav"); p=w.getparams()
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,p.nchannels).astype(float)[:,0]
print("dur",len(d)/44100)
row=0.12
for i,v in enumerate(vals):
    s=int((3*i*row+0.03)*44100); seg=d[s:s+int(0.14*44100)]
    if np.max(np.abs(seg))<200: print(v,"SILENT"); continue
    seg=seg*np.hanning(len(seg)); F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg,8192)); f=np.fft.rfftfreq(8192,1/44100.)
    hz=f[np.argmax(F)]
    print("val",v,"hz",round(hz,1),"st_from_1000",round(12*np.log2(hz/1000),3))
EOF
python3 work/probe5.py"}

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > work/harness.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, base64, json, subprocess, wave, os

SR=8363.0
def pcm_b64(x, sr=SR):
    x=np.asarray(x)
    return base64.b64encode((np.clip(x,-1,1)*32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()).decode()

def run(calls, tag, wav=None, render=True, extra_render=None):
    jf="work/%s.json"%tag
    json.dump(calls, open(jf,"w"))
    r=subprocess.run(["ft2","batch",jf],capture_output=True,text=True)
    errs=[l for l in r.stdout.split("},{") if 'true' in l]
    if render:
        args={"path":"work/%s.wav"%tag,"rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":0}
        if extra_render: args.update(extra_render)
        rr=subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",json.dumps(args)],capture_output=True,text=True)
        try:
            print("render:",json.loads(json.loads(rr.stdout)["content"][0]["text"]))
        except Exception:
            print("render raw:",rr.stdout[:200], rr.stderr[:200])
    return errs

def load(tag):
    w=wave.open("work/%s.wav"%tag); p=w.getparams()
    d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,p.nchannels).astype(float)
    return p.framerate, d

def env(d, hop=882):
    return np.array([np.sqrt(np.mean(d[i:i+hop]**2)) for i in range(0,d.shape[0]-hop,hop)])

def spec(x, n=8192, fs=44100.):
    x=x*np.hanning(len(x)); F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x,n)); f=np.fft.rfftfreq(n,1/fs)
    return f,F

def newmod(ch,name="t",bpm=125,spd=6,rows=64):
    return [{"name":"module_new","arguments":{"channels":ch,"name":name}},
            {"name":"song_set","arguments":{"bpm":bpm,"speed":spd}},
            {"name":"pattern_set_length","arguments":{"pattern":0,"rows":rows}}]

def mk_sustain(f0=220., duty=0.5, head=0.12, loopt=0.15, level=0.5, sr=SR, nharm=None):
    """band-limited pulse: transient head + loop; returns (pcm, loop_start, loop_len)"""
    L=int(loopt*sr); H=int(head*sr)
    if nharm is None: nharm=max(2,int(sr/(8*f0)))
    k=np.arange(1,nharm+1)
    amp=2*np.sin(np.pi*k*duty)/(np.pi*k)
    ph=np.zeros(nharm)
    tt=np.arange(L)/L
    loop=sum((amp[i]*np.cos(2*np.pi*(i+1)*tt+ph[i])) for i in range(nharm))
    loop/=np.max(np.abs(loop))
    # head: attack then decay to level, same periodic wave continues phase from loop start
    tt2=np.arange(H)/L
    head_w=sum((amp[i]*np.cos(2*np.pi*(i+1)*tt2+ph[i])) for i in range(nharm))
    head_w/=np.max(np.abs(head_w))
    n=np.arange(H)
    a=np.minimum(1.0,n/(0.02*sr*3+1))
    dec=level+(1-level)*np.exp(-n/(0.045*sr))
    out=np.concatenate([head_w*a*dec, loop])
    return (out*0.7), H, L
EOF
python3 -c "

import numpy as np
from harness import *
x,hs,ll=mk_sustain()

calls=newmod(2,'sustest')

calls.append({'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'pcm':pcm_b64(x),'encoding':'int16','name':'s'}})

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work')
import numpy as np, json, subprocess
from harness import *
x,hs,ll=mk_sustain(f0=220.,duty=0.5)
def one(tag, cells, rows=64):
    calls=newmod(1,tag,bpm=125,spd=6,rows=rows)
    calls.append({'name':'instrument_set','arguments':{'instrument':1,'name':'S'}})
    calls.append({'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'pcm':pcm_b64(x),'encoding':'int16','name':'s'}})
    calls.append({'name':'sample_set','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'loop_start':hs,'loop_length':ll,'flags':1}})
    for c in cells: calls.append(c)
    json.dump(calls,open("work/%s.json"%tag,"w"))
    r=subprocess.run(["ft2","batch","work/%s.json"%tag],capture_output=True,text=True)
    bad=[j for j in json.loads('['+r.stdout.replace('}\n{','},{')+']') if j.get('isError')]
    if bad: print(tag,"ERRORS:",[b['content'][0]['text'] for b in bad])
    subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",'{"path":"work/%s.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":1}'%tag],capture_output=True)
    fs,d=load(tag); x=d[:,0]*0+np.hanning(1)
    n=int(fs*0.12)
    out=[]
    for i in range(0,min(rows,40),2):
        s=int(i*0.12*fs); seg=d[s:s+n]
        if len(seg)<n: break
        rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2))/32767.
        f,F=spec(seg,8192,fs); pk=f[np.argmax(F)]
        out.append((round(rms,3),int(pk)))
    print(tag, out)
def cell(row,**kw):

function.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > work/eff2.py <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work')
import numpy as np, json, subprocess
from harness import *
x,hs,ll=mk_sustain(f0=220.,duty=0.5)
def pitch(seg, fs=44100.):
    seg=seg-np.mean(seg)
    if np.max(np.abs(seg))<150: return None
    w=seg*np.hanning(len(seg)); n=16384
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(w,n)); f=np.fft.rfftfreq(n,1/fs)
    i=np.argmax(F)
    if i<2: return None
    # parabolic
    a,b,c=F[i-1],F[i],F[i+1]
    dd=0.5*(a-c)/(a-2*b+c) if (a-2*b+c)!=0 else 0
    return f[i]+dd*(f[1]-f[0])
def one(tag, cells, rows=64, notes=None, printall=8):
    calls=newmod(1,tag,bpm=125,spd=6,rows=rows)
    calls.append({'name':'instrument_set','arguments':{'instrument':1,'name':'S'}})
    calls.append({'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'pcm':pcm_b64(x),'encoding':'int16','name':'s'}})
    calls.append({'name':'sample_set','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'loop_start':hs,'loop_length':ll,'flags':1}})
    for c in cells: calls.append(c)
    json.dump(calls,open("work/%s.json"%tag,"w"))
    r=subprocess.run(["ft2","batch","work/%s.json"%tag],capture_output=True,text=True)
    for j in json.loads('['+r.stdout.replace('}\n{','},{')+']'):
        if j.get('isError'): print(tag,"ERR:",j['content'][0]['text'])
    subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",'{"path":"work/%s.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":1}'%tag],capture_output=True)
    fs,d=load(tag); d=d[:,0]
    out=[]
    for i in range(0,rows,1):
        s=int(i*0.12*fs); seg=d[s:s+int(0.06*fs)]
        if len(seg)<1000: break
        rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2))/32767.
        out.append((round(rms,3), round(pitch(seg,fs),1) if pitch(seg,fs) else 0))
    print(tag)
    for i in range(0,min(len(out),48),printall): print("   rows%3d"%i, out[i:i+printall])
def cell(row,note=49,**kw):
    a={'pattern':0,'row':row,'channel':0,'note':note,'instrument':1}; a.update(kw); return {'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':a}
one('vib',[cell(0,effect=4,effect_param=0x4a)])
one('portup',[cell(49,note=0),cell(0,effect=1,effect_param=16)])
one('eff3',[cell(0,effect=3,effect_param=16),cell(10,note=61)])
one('arp',[cell(0,effect=0,effect_param=0x0407)])
one('volslideA',[cell(0,volume=20,effect=10,effect_param=2)])
one('fineport17',[cell(0,effect=17,effect_param=4)])
one('retrig25',[cell(0,effect=25,effect_param=0x34)])
one('notecut28',[cell(0,effect=28,effect_param=6)])
one('rowdelay29',[cell(0,effect=29,effect_param=4)])
EOF
python3 work/eff2.py 2>&1 | tail -30"}

import numpy as np
SR=8363.0
REF=49          # note value that plays the sample at its nominal frequency
def noteval(semitones_from_ref): return REF+semitones_from_ref
def n2f(v, fref=SR/32.0):          # pitch ratio -> Hz of a note (fref = nominal content freq)
    return fref*2.0**((v-REF)/12.0)

def period_samples(hz):  # integer period for given content frequency
    return int(round(SR/hz))

def harmonic_wave(period, harm_amps, phase=0.0):
    """sum of harmonics with period `period` samples -> seamlessly loopable"""
    P=int(period); n=P
    t=np.arange(n)/n
    out=np.zeros(n)
    for k,a in enumerate(harm_amps,start=1):
        if a==0: continue
        out+=a*np.cos(2*np.pi*k*t+phase*k)
    return out

def pulse_amps(duty, nharm, rolloff=1.0, tilt=0.0):
    k=np.arange(1,nharm+1)
    a=np.abs(np.sin(np.pi*k*duty))/np.maximum(k,1e-9)
    a=a*(k**(-rolloff+1.0))
    # zero even harmonics for 50% duty automatically handled by sin term
    a=np.where(np.sin(np.pi*k*duty)>0,a,-a)
    return a

def normalize(x, peak=1.0):
    m=np.max(np.abs(x))
    return x*(peak/m) if m>0 else x

def adsr_percussive(x, decay_t, sr=SR, punch=1.0, noise=None):
    n=len(x); t=np.arange(n)/sr
    e=np.exp(-t/decay_t)
    e[:int(0.002*sr)]*=np.linspace(0.3,1,int(0.002*sr))[:n] if n>int(0.002*sr) else 1
    return x*e

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work')
import numpy as np
from harness import *
from synth import *
P=32
harm=pulse_amps(0.5,16)
w=normalize(harmonic_wave(P,harm))*0.7
loop=np.tile(w,8); head=np.tile(w,2)*np.linspace(0.15,1.0,2*P)
x=np.concatenate([head,loop]); ls=len(head); ll=len(loop)
def build(tag,cells,rows=64,ch=4):
    calls=newmod(ch,tag,bpm=125,spd=6,rows=rows)
    for i in range(1,3):
        calls.append({'name':'instrument_set','arguments':{'instrument':i,'name':'I%d'%i}})
        calls.append({'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':i,'sample':0,'pcm':pcm_b64(x),'encoding':'int16','name':'s%d'%i}})
        calls.append({'name':'sample_set','arguments':{'instrument':i,'sample':0,'loop_start':ls,'loop_length':ll,'flags':1}})
    calls+=cells
    json.dump(calls,open("work/%s.json"%tag,"w"))
    r=subprocess.run(["ft2","batch","work/%s.json"%tag],capture_output=True,text=True)
    for j in json.loads('['+r.stdout.replace('}\n{','},{')+']'):
        if j.get('isError'): print(tag,"ERR:",j['content'][0]['text'])
    subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",'{"path":"work/%s.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":1}'%tag],capture_output=True)
    fs,d=load(tag)
    return fs,d

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work')
import numpy as np, subprocess, json
from harness import *
from synth import *
P=32
harm=pulse_amps(0.5,16)
w=normalize(harmonic_wave(P,harm))*0.7
loop=np.tile(w,8); head=np.tile(w,2)*np.linspace(0.15,1.0,2*P)
x=np.concatenate([head,loop]); ls=len(head); ll=len(loop)
def C(row,ch=0,**kw):
    a={'pattern':0,'row':row,'channel':ch}; a.update(kw); return {'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':a}
def build(tag,cells,rows=64,ch=2,samples=None):
    calls=newmod(ch,tag,bpm=125,spd=6,rows=rows)
    for i,(nm,pcm,l,l2) in enumerate(samples,start=1):
        calls.append({'name':'instrument_set','arguments':{'instrument':i,'name':nm}})
        calls.append({'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':i,'sample':0,'pcm':pcm,'encoding':'int16','name':nm}})
        if l is not None: calls.append({'name':'sample_set','arguments':{'instrument':i,'sample':0,'loop_start':l,'loop_length':l2,'flags':1}})
    calls+=cells
    json.dump(calls,open("work/%s.json"%tag,"w"))
    r=subprocess.run(["ft2","batch","work/%s.json"%tag],capture_output=True,text=True)
    for j in json.loads('['+r.stdout.replace('}\n{','},{')+']'):
        if j.get('isError'): print(tag,"ERR:",j['content'][0]['text'])
    subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",'{"path":"work/%s.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":1}'%tag],capture_output=True)
    return load(tag)
S=[('P',pcm_b64(x),ls,ll)]
# gate test: single channel
fs,d=build('gate',[C(0,note=49,instrument=1,volume=64),C(20,note=0,volume=8),C(30,note=0,volume=64)],ch=1,samples=S)
a=(d[:,0]+d[:,1])/2
def rms(s,e): 
    seg=a[int(s*fs):int(e*fs)]; return round(np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2))/32767.,3)
print("GATE full",rms(0.3,2.2),"gated",rms(2.6,3.4),"back",rms(3.9,5.3))
# pan test: ch0 pan 0 (left), ch1 pan 255 (right)
fs,d=build('pan',[C(0,0,note=49,instrument=1,volume=64,effect=8,effect_param=0x00),
                  C(0,1,note=53,instrument=1,volume=64,effect=8,effect_param=0xF0)],ch=2,samples=S)
print("PAN eff L",round(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[8000:20000,0]**2))/32767.,3),"R",round(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[8000:20000,1]**2))/32767.,3))
# sample panning test
calls=S and None
fs,d=build('span',[C(0,0,note=49,instrument=1,volume=64),C(0,1,note=53,instrument=1,volume=64)],ch=2,samples=S)
print("DEFAULT L",round(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[8000:20000,0]**2))/32767.,3),"R",round(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[8000:20000,1]**2))/32767.,3))
EOF

"""Sample factory: all material generated here. Content sample rate 8363 Hz.
Reference: note value 49 plays content at its nominal pitch (C-4, 261.34 Hz)."""
import numpy as np
SR = 8363.0
P0 = 32                      # samples per cycle of the nominal reference tone (SR/32 = 261.34 Hz)

def b64(x):
    import base64
    x = np.clip(np.asarray(x, dtype=float), -1.0, 1.0)
    return base64.b64encode((x * 32000).astype(np.int16).tobytes()).decode()

def harm_wave(period, amps, phase=0.0):
    """periodic waveform of `period` samples built from harmonics (seamless loop)."""
    P = int(period)
    t = np.arange(P) / P
    out = np.zeros(P)
    for k, a in enumerate(amps, start=1):
        if a == 0: continue
        out += a * np.cos(2 * np.pi * k * t + phase * k)
    return out

def pulse_amps(duty, nharm):
    k = np.arange(1, nharm + 1)
    return 2 * np.sin(np.pi * k * duty) / (np.pi * k)

def saw_amps(nharm):
    k = np.arange(1, nharm + 1)
    return ((-1) ** (k + 1)) * 1.0 / k

def tri_amps(nharm):
    k = np.arange(1, nharm + 1)
    a = np.zeros(nharm)
    for i, kk in enumerate(k):
        if kk % 2 == 1:
            a[i] = ((-1) ** ((kk - 1) // 2)) * 1.0 / (kk * kk)
    return 8 / np.pi ** 2 * a

def norm(x, peak=1.0):
    m = np.max(np.abs(x))
    return x * (peak / m) if m > 0 else x

def click(n, sr=SR, decay=0.004, amp=1.0):
    n = int(n); t = np.arange(n) / sr
    return amp * (np.random.RandomState(7).randn(n) * 0.6 + np.sin(2*np.pi*2400*t)) * np.exp(-t/decay)

def swept(n, f_start, f_end, tau, sr=SR, shape='exp'):
    """sine with exponentially decaying instantaneous frequency"""
    n = int(n); t = np.arange(n) / sr
    f = f_end + (f_start - f_end) * np.exp(-t / tau)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / sr
    return np.sin(ph)

def noise_decay(n, decay, sr=SR, hp=0.0, lp=0.0, rs=3):
    n = int(n); rng = np.random.RandomState(rs)
    x = rng.randn(n)
    if hp > 0:                       # simple one-pole highpass
        y = np.zeros(n); prev = 0.0; a = hp
        for i in range(n):
            y[i] = x[i] - prev
            prev = y[i] * (1 - a)
        x = y
    if lp > 0:
        y = np.zeros(n); s = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            s += (x[i] - s) * lp; y[i] = s
        x = y
    t = np.arange(n) / sr
    return x * np.exp(-t / decay)

def adsr_looped(wave_fn, att, dec, sus, loop_periods, sr=SR):
    """returns (samples, loop_start, loop_len).  wave_fn(scale)->waveform of period P0"""
    base = wave_fn(1.0)
    head = np.tile(base, 4)
    n = len(head); t = np.arange(n) / sr
    e = np.minimum(1.0, t / max(att, 1e-5))
    e = np.where(t < att, e, sus + (1 - sus) * np.exp(-(t - att) / max(dec, 1e-5)))
    xh = head * e
    nl = int(loop_periods) * P0
    loop = np.tile(base, int(loop_periods)) * sus
    # smooth the head/loop junction
    x = np.concatenate([xh, loop])
    return x, len(xh), nl, base

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- instruments
def make_kick():
    n = int(0.40 * SR)
    body = swept(n, 340, 52, 0.030) * np.exp(-np.arange(n) / SR / 0.085)
    totp = swept(n, 900, 160, 0.012) * np.exp(-np.arange(n) / SR / 0.020) * 0.35
    x = norm(body + totp, 0.9) * np.minimum(1.0, np.arange(n) / (0.0015 * SR) + 0.2)
    return x, None, None

def make_snare():
    n = int(0.34 * SR)
    nz = noise_decay(n, 0.085, hp=0.35, lp=0.55, rs=11) * 0.85
    tn = swept(n, 330, 190, 0.02) * np.exp(-np.arange(n) / SR / 0.05) * 0.5
    x = norm(nz + tn + click(0.01*SR, decay=0.003, amp=0.5), 0.52)
    return x, None, None

def make_hat():
    n = int(0.10 * SR)
    x = noise_decay(n, 0.020, hp=0.85, lp=0.9, rs=5)
    x += 0.25 * np.sin(2*np.pi*np.arange(n)/SR*3100) * np.exp(-np.arange(n)/SR/0.02)
    x += 0.2 * np.sin(2*np.pi*np.arange(n)/SR*3900) * np.exp(-np.arange(n)/SR/0.017)
    return norm(x, 0.30), None, None

def make_open():
    n = int(0.62 * SR)
    x = noise_decay(n, 0.20, hp=0.8, lp=0.9, rs=9)
    x += 0.22*np.sin(2*np.pi*np.arange(n)/SR*2900)*np.exp(-np.arange(n)/SR/0.22)
    x += 0.18*np.sin(2*np.pi*np.arange(n)/SR*3750)*np.exp(-np.arange(n)/SR/0.19)
    return norm(x, 0.24), None, None

def make_tom():
    n = int(0.45 * SR)
    x = swept(n, 300, 110, 0.06) * np.exp(-np.arange(n)/SR/0.13)
    x += 0.25*noise_decay(n, 0.02, rs=13)*0.5
    return norm(x, 0.55), None, None

def make_clap():
    n = int(0.35 * SR)
    x = np.zeros(n)
    t = np.arange(n)/SR
    for k, off in enumerate([0, 0.011, 0.022, 0.033]):
        i = int(off*SR)
        seg = noise_decay(n-i, 0.028 if k < 3 else 0.11, hp=0.5, lp=0.7, rs=21+k)
        x[i:i+len(seg)] += seg * (1.0 if k < 3 else 0.8)
    return norm(x, 0.42), None, None

def make_bass():
    """plucky punchy pulse with bright attack transient"""
    amps = pulse_amps(0.25, 16)
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    n = int(0.42 * SR)
    reps = n // P0 + 1
    x = np.tile(w, reps)[:n].astype(float)
    # slight extra bite: unison detuned copy is out; use harmonic 2 boost
    t = np.arange(n)/SR
    e = np.minimum(1.0, t/0.0015) * (0.30 + 0.70*np.exp(-t/0.075)) * np.exp(-t/0.13)
    x = x*e + click(int(0.02*SR), decay=0.005, amp=0.30)*np.concatenate([np.ones(int(0.02*SR)), np.zeros(n-int(0.02*SR))])
    return norm(x, 0.60), None, None

def make_basssub():
    amps = pulse_amps(0.5, 10)
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    x, ls, ll, base = adsr_looped(lambda s: w, 0.004, 0.09, 0.72, 12)
    return norm(x, 0.46), ls, ll

def make_chip():
    amps = pulse_amps(0.125, 16)
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    n = int(0.16*SR); reps = n//P0+1
    x = np.tile(w, reps)[:n].astype(float)
    t = np.arange(n)/SR
    x = x*np.minimum(1, t/0.001)*(np.exp(-t/0.035))
    return norm(x, 0.34), None, None

def make_chip2():
    amps = pulse_amps(0.5, 12)
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    n = int(0.26*SR); reps = n//P0+1
    x = np.tile(w, reps)[:n].astype(float)
    t = np.arange(n)/SR
    x = x*np.minimum(1, t/0.0015)*(0.35+0.65*np.exp(-t/0.09))
    return norm(x, 0.27), None, None

def make_lead():
    amps = pulse_amps(0.28, 16).copy()
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    x, ls, ll, base = adsr_looped(lambda s: w, 0.003, 0.13, 0.78, 16)
    return norm(x, 0.52), ls, ll

def make_lead2():
    amps = saw_amps(14)*0.8 + pulse_amps(0.5, 14)*0.5
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    x, ls, ll, base = adsr_looped(lambda s: w, 0.02, 0.25, 0.85, 16)
    return norm(x, 0.30), ls, ll

def make_pad():
    amps = tri_amps(10)*1.0 + pulse_amps(0.5, 4)*0.4
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    x, ls, ll, base = adsr_looped(lambda s: w, 0.16, 0.5, 0.8, 24)
    return norm(x, 0.20), ls, ll

def make_stab():
    amps = pulse_amps(0.2, 16).copy()
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    n = int(0.30*SR); reps = n//P0+1
    x = np.tile(w, reps)[:n].astype(float)
    t = np.arange(n)/SR
    x = x*np.minimum(1, t/0.001)*(np.exp(-t/0.06))*(0.5+0.5*np.exp(-t/0.01))
    return norm(x, 0.30), None, None

def make_riser():
    n = int(3.0*SR)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(3)
    x = rng.randn(n)
    # moving one-pole lowpass (rising)
    y = np.zeros(n); s = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        a = 0.01 + 0.5*(i/n)**2.2
        s += (x[i]-s)*a
        y[i] = s
    y = norm(y, 1.0)
    t = np.arange(n)/SR
    env = (t/3.0)**2.0
    # add rising pitch shimmer
    f = 300*np.exp(np.log(8)*t*t/9.0)
    sh = np.sin(2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/SR)*0.4*np.exp(-t/2.2)
    return norm(y*env + sh*env, 0.30), None, None

def make_harp():
    """fast bright pluck used for glissandos / pickups"""
    amps = pulse_amps(0.5, 16)
    w = harm_wave(P0, amps)
    n = int(0.22*SR); reps = n//P0+1
    x = np.tile(w, reps)[:n].astype(float)
    t = np.arange(n)/SR
    x = x*np.minimum(1, t/0.0008)*np.exp(-t/0.045)
    return norm(x, 0.34), None, None

INSTRUMENTS = [
    ("KICK",   make_kick),
    ("SNARE",  make_snare),
    ("HAT",    make_hat),
    ("OPENHAT",make_open),
    ("TOM",    make_tom),
    ("CLAP",   make_clap),
    ("BASS",   make_bass),
    ("SUBBASS",make_basssub),
    ("CHIP",   make_chip),
    ("CHIP2",  make_chip2),
    ("LEAD",   make_lead),
    ("LEAD2",  make_lead2),
    ("PAD",    make_pad),
    ("STAB",   make_stab),
    ("RISER",  make_riser),
    ("HARP",   make_harp),
]
def build_all():
    out = []
    for name, fn in INSTRUMENTS:
        x, ls, ll = fn()
        out.append((name, x, ls, ll))
        print("%-8s len=%6d  peak=%.2f  loop=%s" % (name, len(x), np.max(np.abs(x)), (ls, ll)))
    return out

import sys, json, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work')
import factory, sections as S, music

CH = 12
def sample_calls():
    calls = []
    for i, (name, x, ls, ll) in enumerate(factory.build_all(), start=1):
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
        # DC block everything
        k = int(factory.SR*0.02)
        kern = np.ones(k)/k
        sm = np.convolve(x, kern, mode='same')
        x = x - sm
        calls.append({"name":"instrument_set","arguments":{"instrument":i,"name":name}})
        calls.append({"name":"sample_create_from_pcm","arguments":{"instrument":i,"sample":0,
                      "pcm":factory.b64(x*0.98),"encoding":"int16","name":name}})
        a = {"instrument":i,"sample":0}
        if ls is not None:
            a.update({"loop_start":int(ls),"loop_length":int(ll),"flags":1})
        calls.append({"name":"sample_set","arguments":a})
    return calls

def pattern_calls(names):
    calls = []
    for pi, nm in enumerate(names):
        p, chords = S.SECTIONS[nm]()
        calls.append({"name":"pattern_set_length","arguments":{"pattern":pi,"rows":64}})
        calls.append({"name":"pattern_clear","arguments":{"pattern":pi}})
        for (row, c), kw in sorted(p.cells.items()):
            if c >= CH: continue
            a = {"pattern":pi,"row":row,"channel":c}
            a.update(kw)
            calls.append({"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":a})
    return calls

if __name__ == '__main__':
    uniq = []
    for nm in S.ORDER:
        if nm not in uniq: uniq.append(nm)
    print("unique patterns:", list(enumerate(uniq)))
    setup = [{"name":"module_new","arguments":{"channels":CH,"name":"Neon Skyline"}}]
    setup += [{"name":"song_set","arguments":{"bpm":music.BPM,"speed":music.SPEED}}]
    setup += sample_calls()
    json.dump(setup, open('work/b_setup.json','w'))
    pc = pattern_calls(uniq)
    nsplit = 4
    per = (len(pc)+nsplit-1)//nsplit
    for i in range(nsplit):
        json.dump(pc[i*per:(i+1)*per], open('work/b_pat%d.json'%i,'w'))
    order = []
    for pos, nm in enumerate(S.ORDER):
        order.append({"name":"order_set","arguments":{"position":pos,"pattern":uniq.index(nm)}})
    order.append({"name":"song_set","arguments":{"length":len(S.ORDER),"loop_start":0,"bpm":music.BPM,"speed":music.SPEED}})
    json.dump(order, open('work/b_order.json','w'))
    print("calls: setup %d  patterns %d  order %d" % (len(setup), len(pc), len(order)))
EOF

import sys, json, subprocess, numpy as np, wave
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work')
import factory, music, sections as S
from music import VAL, OFF

def solo_check(pattern_name, chans, label="solo"):
    p, chords = S.SECTIONS[pattern_name]()
    calls=[{"name":"module_new","arguments":{"channels":12,"name":"solo"}}]
    calls+=[{"name":"song_set","arguments":{"bpm":music.BPM,"speed":music.SPEED}},
            {"name":"pattern_set_length","arguments":{"pattern":0,"rows":64}},
            {"name":"pattern_clear","arguments":{"pattern":0}},
            {"name":"song_set","arguments":{"length":1,"loop_start":0}}]
    for i,(name,x,ls,ll) in enumerate(factory.build_all(), start=1):
        x=np.asarray(x,float); k=int(factory.SR*0.02); x=x-np.convolve(x,np.ones(k)/k,mode='same')
        calls.append({"name":"instrument_set","arguments":{"instrument":i,"name":name}})
        calls.append({"name":"sample_create_from_pcm","arguments":{"instrument":i,"sample":0,"pcm":factory.b64(x*0.9),"encoding":"int16","name":name}})
        a={"instrument":i,"sample":0}
        if ls is not None: a.update({"loop_start":int(ls),"loop_length":int(ll),"flags":1})
        calls.append({"name":"sample_set","arguments":a})
    for (row,c),kw in sorted(p.cells.items()):
        if c not in chans: continue
        a={"pattern":0,"row":row,"channel":c}; a.update(kw)
        calls.append({"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":a})
    json.dump(calls,open("work/b_solo.json","w"))
    subprocess.run(["ft2","batch","work/b_solo.json"],capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(["ft2","call","module_render",'{"path":"work/solo.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":32,"loops":0}'],capture_output=True)
    w=wave.open("work/solo.wav"); pp=w.getparams()
    d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,pp.nchannels).astype(float)[:,0]
    fs=pp.framerate
    notes=[]
    prev=None
    for r in range(64):
        seg=d[int(r*0.1*fs)+200:int(r*0.1*fs)+int(0.075*fs)]
        if np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2))<80: 
            cur=None
        else:
            ac=np.correlate(seg,seg,'full')[len(seg)-1:]
            lo=int(fs/1200); hi=int(fs/55)
            a2=ac[lo:hi]
            if len(a2)<10 or np.max(a2)<=0: cur=None
            else:
                lag=np.argmax(a2)+lo
                f=fs/lag
                cur=int(round(12*np.log2(f/(factory.SR/32.0))+49))   # value
        if cur!=prev:
            notes.append((r,cur))
            prev=cur
    print(label, pattern_name, "ch",chans)
    print("   detected (row->notevalue):", [(r, n) for r,n in notes if n is not None])
